verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR/payroll/PEO platform, so API-driven onboarding of new hires is a fair question, but the evidence shows only UI-based workflows. Tax withholding is collected when employees enroll themselves, not via any API, and there is no documentation of endpoints for creating employees, setting compensation, or configuring tax setup. The OpenAPI and llms.txt probes both returned 404, so nothing shows an agent could do this programmatically.
